svg.text: Dotnet · D23 · Unit the rules. HTTP-test the pipeline. Mock the edge.
Fast rules, then seams, then a few real paths.
Verifying internals locks the design and misses bugs.
If routing can break it, a unit test will not see it.
An integration test you can defend
POST, isolated data, assert status and body.
HTTP in, contract out — isolated data
The lie lived in routing, DI, and serialization.
Controller unit tests can pass while routing and JSON are broken.
